<thought>All peaks between ~128 ppm and ~138 ppm correspond to aromatic carbons. Their multiplicities are: 137.56 ppm (2 carbons), 131.90 ppm (2 carbons), 130.00 ppm (4 carbons), 128.40 ppm (4 carbons). Summing these gives 2 + 2 + 4 + 4 = 12 aromatic carbons.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
